verdict.rationale: Supabase ships first-party background automation primitives. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs (from every second to once a year) via SQL or the Dashboard, and those jobs can run SQL or invoke Edge Functions. Queues offers durable background tasks with guaranteed delivery, and Database Webhooks fire HTTP calls on table events. The MCP docs also explicitly cover unattended agent routines with pre-approved read-only tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably, and a native AI-agent-driven autonomous automation feature (the agentic routines themselves run in the external agent host, not in Supabase).
